title: Martsirt lite pass (exterior)
repo_rule: ADD-ONLY: every *_lite file is a new sibling; no live file, placements.json, martsirt_world.json, interiors, colliders, manifest.json, asset_version.txt, ASSET_MAP.md, GLB_LIST.md or code changed.
switch_over: Engine maps live path -> lite path (files[].live -> files[].lite) for the Martsirt exterior only, and reads materials/manifest_lite.json + ground map. Interiors keep loading the live GLBs.
measurement: tris/draws counted the way the engine renders the exterior: hidden names (col_/nav_/npc_spot_/fx_/ground_mud/ground_bay_mud/plaza/decals_square; shrine col_/fx_/interact; tree col_) excluded; draw call = one visible primitive; shadow draws use the engine castShadow rules (props none, life <1 m none, m_ground/m_wood_floor/m_fire_ and water/creek/bridge/river names none); totals multiply by instance counts.

textures.formula: GPU estimate = w*h*4 bytes*4/3 (RGBA8 + mips), per unique image

materials_manifest.note: same schema; tex_1k entries point at *_512.jpg siblings. Engine: fetch manifest_lite.json instead of manifest.json for exteriors.

kept_1k.why: church facade hero: chapel (7.5k tris) + tower (7.5k tris) facades, 2 m tiling; visible as the largest lit surface from the 50-degree camera. Normal map for it is 512.
main ground hero: covers most of the screen at all times

ground.note: martsirt_splat.png / martsirt_ao.png are data maps, unchanged.

embedded.rules: characters_art props + shrine 2048->512, tree atlas 1024->512, gothic props kept 512 except small props (<1.5 m: wall_sconce, tombstone, anvil, chains, lectern, hanging_sign) 512->256, tapestry 1024->512
